description:
A standalone UAR backed by a separate SurrealDB server must become ready
  again by itself after that server restarts, without restarting UAR (#441).

steps.name: a standalone UAR backed by a remote SurrealDB server and an owned skill
the SurrealDB server restarts while UAR keeps running
readiness returns to ready within 90 seconds without restarting UAR
the owned skill is still readable and a new skill can be saved
the UAR log records the transport loss and its recovery
